test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A window will have been opened by her.

options.text: She will be opened a window.
She will have opened a window.
She will have been opened a window.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In Active Voice,** a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• **In Passive Voice,** a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and **"A window"** is the subject and ‘**her**’ is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into active voice:
 
• The subject "A window" of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object ‘**her**’ becomes the subject.
 
• **‘her’** is converted into **‘she'** for the subjective case. ‘**By**’ will be removed.
 
• The sentence is in the future perfect tense.
 
• The passive format **"will have been + opened(V3)" **is used and the active format **"will have + opened (V3)"** should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the future perfect tense.

Hence, the correct active voice is ***"She will have opened a window."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In voice change, **TENSE** will **never** change.
